answer: A ripple record in shale decides paying status. Wandering patrols check live jobs in random clusters, staking 50 POA per check; each clean check lays one shale layer stamped with patrol, cluster, date. It unlocks at three layers from three different patrols inside 60 days, so the ripple must keep spreading. A false layer burns 50 POA and voids that layer. Forging 1,000 fakes takes 3,000 bribes at 300 POA, 900,000 POA in all, plus 150,000 POA of stakes at risk and 60 days no shortcut can compress. A riverbed proves its age in shale laid by many floods, not one.
